mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 for the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and housing market activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS * HOUST) fails to predict SPX 60-day returns with Rank IC above 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or interaction effect is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high industrial production (INDPRO above 105), manufacturing activity signals robust corporate capacity utilization and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an effective monetary policy response to a cooling labor market, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing with labor market improvement
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS change * UNRATE change) fails to predict SPX 60-day returns with Rank IC above 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or interaction effect is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 650 thousand units, it indicates a strong housing market that stimulates consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 650, or Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.
